title: Capture an Idea Without Breaking Current Workflow
description: Capture strategic ideas instantly in Idea Board while preserving focus on in-progress operational tasks.
prerequisites: You are signed into your current workspace session.
Idea tags/categories are available for classification.
steps: Open Idea Board from your current workspace without abandoning the active operational task.
Create a new idea entry with a concise title and one-paragraph context.
Add tags for theme, urgency, and strategic area so the idea is easy to retrieve later.
Save the idea and return immediately to your in-progress workflow, such as payroll or task execution.
During Master Mind or strategy review sessions, filter by tags and pull the idea into discussion.
Promote selected ideas into actionable project pipelines when ready for execution.
validations: The idea is saved and searchable by tags.
Current operational workflow remains uninterrupted after capture.
The idea can be retrieved and promoted in strategic planning sessions.
commonErrors: Idea is saved without tags and later becomes hard to find.
User loses context of active workflow while capturing idea.
Idea never gets reviewed or promoted into execution planning.
recovery: Edit idea metadata to add meaningful tags and ownership.
Use quick-capture template to minimize interruption time.
Set recurring strategy review to triage and promote backlog ideas.

faq.question: Should I fully plan an idea when it appears?
faq.answer: No. Capture quickly with enough context, then refine during dedicated strategy sessions.

faq.question: How do ideas become action?
faq.answer: Tag, review in Master Mind sessions, then convert selected ideas into project pipeline items.
